name: rv32f_only_120mhz

frequency_promotion.reason: The unified 120 MHz implementation still has setup violations, so the user-specified zero-violation promotion condition was not met.

rtl_changes: FPnew is configured for a 32-bit datapath with only the FP32 format enabled
floating-point register, issue, scoreboard, completion and memory paths are narrowed from 64 to 32 bits
FLD/FSD state is removed and binary64 decode requests trap as illegal instructions
MISA advertises RV32IMF instead of RV32IMFD
the v1.5 FMA/CONV pipeline boundaries are retained
branch predictor RTL and prediction policy are unchanged

critical_path.block: branch predictor BTB read through interconnect/data-memory reset control
critical_path.logic: 3 CARRY4, 1 LUT3, 1 LUT4, 2 LUT5 and 8 LUT6

comparison_to_v1_5.note: Removing FP64 eliminates the previous FP64 FMA critical path and greatly reduces resources, but the deterministic placer exposes a non-FPU frontend/interconnect path; therefore WNS/TNS are slightly worse than v1.5 despite the area reduction.

coremark.profile_optimization: CoreMark kernels -O3; RT-Thread, FinSH and formatting support -Os

trials.name: O3 CoreMark plus Os runtime firmware
incremental implementation from v1.5 DCP
trials.reason: Vivado disabled incremental reuse because cell/net matching was only 67.06/64.19 percent; subsequent placement checksums and timing estimates exactly matched the selected deterministic run

artifacts.bitstream_export: Manual write_bitstream from fpga_top_postroute_physopt.dcp after the implementation strategy stopped after post-route physical optimization

board_safety.historical_trap_avoided: MMCM, board metadata, RTL/software clock contract, timer, UART, CoreMark timebase and embedded firmware remain one generated 120 MHz set; the MMCM was not changed in isolation.

reason: v2.1 fulfills the requested RV32F-only architecture, passes WSL functional and CoreMark gates, stays below 4000000 cycles, and sharply reduces FP resources. It remains at 120 MHz because setup timing is not clean; the remaining critical paths are outside the removed FP64 datapath.
